senses.gloss: प्र ind. As a prefix to verbal themes it means, ‘forward, before, in front, onward, away &c.’It is compounded with nouns not immediately derived from verbs in the sense of- (1) ‘forth, away,’ (e.g. प्रपौत्र); (2) ‘without, destitute of,’ (e.g. प्रपर्णो वृक्षः); (3) excellent, (e.g. प्राचार्य); (4) begin, (e.g. प्राह्ण); (5) formed, folded, (e.g. प्रांजलि); (6) intense, (e.g. प्रगुण); (7) prominent, (e.g. प्रणस); (8) apart, (e.g. प्रजु); (9) complete &c.; and with adjectives in the sense of ‘excessively, much, very,’ (e.g. प्रमत्त).
